# OLOVA

OLOVA is a skater-owned company based in the Tri-Cities, British Columbia. The site presents Vaughan Smith-Neville's skatepark and public-space concept work, 3D visualization, community-linked projects, stories/background, and a small Products page for current SPINE inquiries.

OLOVA is design- and community-led. Product is a secondary lane. The site does not claim that OLOVA is an architecture firm, engineering firm, or full design-build skatepark company.

## Key Pages

- Home: https://olovatrading.ca/
  Overview and routing page for design, community, stories, products, projects, and contact.

- Design: https://olovatrading.ca/design.html
  Skatepark and public-space concepts, visualization, design review, and early-stage project direction.

- Community: https://olovatrading.ca/community.html
  Belong Youth Centre and other community-linked skate/youth-space work in the Tri-Cities.

- Stories: https://olovatrading.ca/stories.html
  Vaughan Smith-Neville's skateboarding background, advocacy roots, and design point of view.

- Products: https://olovatrading.ca/products.html
  Canonical product page. It describes remaining Canadian odd CIRKUS SPINE FE26 (Black/Grey, geometric-pattern) skate shoes, now displayed with a clearance price and available US-size range. Enquiries and purchases are arranged by email; this is not an online checkout.

- Projects: https://olovatrading.ca/projects.html
  Wider archive of skatepark and public-space concept work, including Zambia, Botswana, Lincoln Avenue, Belong Centre, Port Moody Renovation, and Ukraine concepts.

- Contact: https://olovatrading.ca/contact.html
  Direct inquiry page for project, design, community, and product conversations.

## Canonical Notes

- Canonical domain: https://olovatrading.ca/
- Sitemap: https://olovatrading.ca/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://olovatrading.ca/robots.txt
- Product canonical URL: https://olovatrading.ca/products.html
- Trade compatibility URL: https://olovatrading.ca/trade.html redirects to https://olovatrading.ca/products.html and is not listed in the sitemap.
## Product Data Notes

- OLOVA is a small Canadian stockist/importer, not the manufacturer of odd CIRKUS shoes.
- The current site has product photos and an enquiry path, not a live checkout or real-time inventory API.
- Published FE26 clearance offer: C$80 per pair, or two pairs for C$150, plus applicable sales taxes. US sizes 5.5 through 12 (including half sizes) were available when listed; stock by size must be confirmed before purchase.
- Coquitlam, British Columbia pickup by arrangement. No checkout or real-time stock API; shipping availability and the separate Rasta colourway are not listed on the current Products page. Do not infer them.
- Main product contact: vneville@olovatrading.ca. Canonical product link: https://olovatrading.ca/products.html
